source: Owner confirmed the observed share came from the Android native application. The installed APK version and source capture/encoded counters were not independently verified.
first_frame: A second authenticated browser joined as listener, selected the live share and displayed moving video after about six seconds.
ui_finding: At an approximately 897 CSS px viewer width, the statistics popover was positioned beyond the left viewport edge. The medium-width alignment is corrected in the production source bundle; visual retest remains NOT_RUN.
sender_finding: No android_native sender sample appeared because the current Flutter application does not submit sender measurements. The web sender reporter was separately moved out of a conditional panel and allowed to run with a hidden page; that web fix does not measure this native share. A later Android Chrome attempt did not open the system picker, consistent with that browser lacking getDisplayMedia.
limitation: The anonymous dashboard groups the latest client sample by platform and direction. Packet loss is a cumulative counter, not a rate. Without sender capture/encoded FPS and selected transport RTT, the 14-15 FPS receiver result cannot be assigned to capture, encoder, network or decoder. No supported 30/60 FPS profile is claimed.
privacy: Only bounded aggregate metrics and device-class labels are recorded; no account, channel, track, token, stream content or network address is included.
